name: dsfd_capt_x8x_s_w_split1016z

pin_regs.reason: Designed-in pin flops: every output is launched by a flop at its pin (banks / s_mark / s_par / t_vm stage B / t_ho; io_flop_at_pins), every input is captured by its first flop through at most one fixed-epoch enable/select mux (bank write enable at sample index n; x43 read select at serial edge 0/1/2; marker/parity samples at index 2/0) -- those flops ARE the pin registers of the 3:4 transfer.  A separate recipe-3 stage would add a stream cycle (t) / serial cycle (s) per crossing and sample the banks at every serial edge (1-tick windows on the seam) for no timing benefit; native audit (capture <= 190 / launch <= 220) applies.

structural_change: split1016z b[1197] 219.6 ps (63 pins) after the default hold ECO: re-route of the same split1016z kit with a near-miss hold ECO goal (hold_eco.hold_margin_ps 3): b786448b1 pre-ECO capture 168.6, FF -1.43 on one ad0 -> bd0 cross-entry arc; the default ECO window (36.9 ps) padded 230 seam inputs.  split1016z re-kit of dsfd_capt_x8x_s_w (split1016y routed CLOSED but fails native capture: b[624] 192.3 ps, 2 pins): two literal entries of the one ckv root: ckv[0] clocks stage A (seam bank reads), the row counters, s_mark / s_par and the reset chain; ckvb[0] clocks only the 832 stage-B t_vm flops of the S band.  split1016y's single tree hung rows 0-2 of stage A on the band's half of the tree (stage-A clock 119..173 ps, 5 hold BUFx2 on the worst seam paths); with its own root the seam column is balanced to its own boundary reference.  Same RTL logic and cycles (stage B one serial edge after stage A), split1016y outline and seam.  split1016y re-kit of dsfd_capt_x8x_s_w (closed split1016x view fails native capture: b[3] 200.4 ps, 4 pins, all row 0): seam slot block 10.8 um higher in a 86.4 x 183.6 serial leaf (was 86.4 x 172.8, seam from y 4.99): row 0's stage-A capture flops leave the S-face t_vm stage-B band (y 2-14) and its late ckv branch (row 0 ckv 172-176 ps vs 133-143 mid rows; input hold repair put 4-5 BUFx2 on each row-0 seam path, TT data 209.5 ps); t leaf unchanged, the parent places it DS above the s origin so the seam stays mirror-aligned; no RTL change.  DECISION B successor of dsfd_capt_x8_data_w (split1016 / split1016b: FF hold -84 ps on 3,376 intra-leaf ck->ckv R2R arcs of 8 x ot_ratio_cdc_fifo, hold repair stalled: the 256.67 ps 4:3 window cannot carry the 100 ps hold + 150 ps setup cross-entry reserve).  The 8 dsfd_capt_row_local rows (dynamic hold queue + pair packer + ratio FIFO) become fixed-bank 3:4 transfers on the common epoch (ot_s81_vm_x43 contract) split per clock root: dsfd_capt_x8x_t (ck) samples f_w into bank n at EVERY stream index n = 0..3 (no index is a fault: capture words arrive on any stream cycle); dsfd_capt_x8x_s (ckv) reads b0+b1 at serial edge 2, b2 at edge 0, b3 at edge 1 (stage A) and registers t_vm one serial edge later at the S face (stage B).  Hold queue removed (no word can be refused); t_ho = sticky epoch-slip fault (stream side checks the serial marker/parity).  Latency f_w sample edge -> t_vm: 3.333/2.500/2.778/3.056 ns for n = 0/1/2/3, one serial cycle LESS than the old leaf's best case (measured: tb_dsfd_capt_x8_x43).  Every leaf pin is a flop; outhold off (bank outputs rewritten >= 1.11 ns after their fixed read).  Parent footprint 118.8 x 172.8 (old 108 x 162): bit-major seam needs 1,680 M4 pins at 0.096 um; t width 32.4 for two 10.5 pins/um faces (gate oflop).
